name: Drowned Choir
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Shadowed Withdrawal (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the choir takes the Hide action.

abilities.name: Drowning Retort (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: One creature within 5 feet that hit the choir with an attack roll since the end of the choir's last turn takes 7 (2d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The choir makes three Chord attacks.

actions.name: Chord
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage.

generation.userConcept: a drowned cathedral choir that sings in one voice
generation.cite: composition after Assassin (CR 8) — the rider-heavy burst and the expertise Stealth
